name: Adaptive Beam Generation
definition: A method to generate caustic beams by rasterizing specular surfaces from the light's perspective into a G-buffer, projecting a planar grid onto these surfaces, and adaptively refining the resulting grid triangles based on geometric discontinuities, beam energy, and camera parameters.
summary: Adaptive Beam Generation rasterizes specular surfaces into a G-buffer and adaptively refines projected grid triangles based on geometric discontinuities, beam energy, and camera proximity.
